Christopher Nolan film boosts Indian IMAX records and UK poetry sales

Christopher Nolan's film 'The Odyssey' has become the highest-grossing IMAX release in India. In the UK, the film's adaptation of Homer's poem has contributed to a significant increase in poetry sales, which are projected to reach a record high for the year. Poetry sales in the UK have already surpassed £8 million in the first 30 weeks of 2026.
